dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: The bench is behind us.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Sister
dialogue_turns.text: The bus is near the corner.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, I can see the bus near the corner.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Sister
dialogue_turns.text: Good. We are ready.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: The poster is above the ticket table.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: We are in the station hall.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: The poster is easy to read.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, I can see the picture clearly.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: Good. The display is clear.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: The map book is open on the table.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: The two chairs are beside us.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: The places look interesting.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, I can talk about the places in the book.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: Good. I am interested too.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Adult
dialogue_turns.text: Your note card is on the table.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Anna
dialogue_turns.text: The pencil is on the small shelf.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Adult
dialogue_turns.text: The information desk is ready.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Anna
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, I can find a pencil for my note.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Adult
dialogue_turns.text: Good. You are ready to write.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: The town map is open.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Leo
dialogue_turns.text: The station is marked near the centre.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: I am beside you.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Leo
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, I can find the station on the map.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Friend
dialogue_turns.text: Good. The map is clear.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Family Member
dialogue_turns.text: The library is marked near the station.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Nina
dialogue_turns.text: The information map is beside us.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Family Member
dialogue_turns.text: The route is clear.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Nina
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, I can point to the library.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Family Member
dialogue_turns.text: Good. We know the way.
